$comment: Packages whose config plugin npx expo prebuild applies on its own, with default options, when the package is installed (autolinked) and app.config.ts does not list it. Verified on 2026-10-04 in @expo/prebuild-config 57.0.16 (build/plugins/withDefaultPlugins.js: versionedExpoSDKPackages, legacyExpoPlugins, expoManagedVersionedPlugins). "defaults" lists what a default application adds, as seen in npx expo config --type introspect of an SDK 57 app on 2026-10-04 (only packages checked there are listed). "blockable" lists permissions a plugin adds whatever its options, so only android.blockedPermissions removes them (read in the plugin source). Re-verify: grep -n "versionedExpoSDKPackages =\|legacyExpoPlugins =\|expoManagedVersionedPlugins =" node_modules/@expo/prebuild-config/build/plugins/withDefaultPlugins.js

exempt.expo-system-ui: its plugin only mirrors the top-level userInterfaceStyle and backgroundColor keys
exempt.expo-updates: its plugin only mirrors the top-level updates and runtimeVersion keys
exempt.expo-navigation-bar: its plugin only mirrors the top-level androidNavigationBar key
exempt.expo-ads-admob: removed from the SDK; listed by prebuild for old projects only
exempt.expo-app-auth: removed from the SDK; listed by prebuild for old projects only
exempt.expo-firebase-analytics: removed from the SDK; listed by prebuild for old projects only
exempt.expo-firebase-core: removed from the SDK; listed by prebuild for old projects only
exempt.expo-google-sign-in: removed from the SDK; listed by prebuild for old projects only
exempt.expo-inline-modules: not an installable package's defaults: prebuild-config's own unversioned withInlineModules plugin, which runs for every app and acts only on experiments.inlineModules

expo-file-system.why: withFileSystem (expo-file-system 57 plugin/build/withFileSystem.js) adds these and INTERNET whatever its options; only android.blockedPermissions removes them. INTERNET is left out: every React Native app needs it. Blocking both storage permissions silences the transitive note.

defaults.expo-apple-authentication: the Sign in with Apple entitlement (com.apple.developer.applesignin), which every signing profile must then allow
defaults.expo-notifications: the aps-environment push entitlement, which every signing profile must then allow
defaults.expo-image-picker: generic English camera, microphone and photo-library purpose strings and the Android RECORD_AUDIO permission (microphonePermission: false removes both microphone parts)
defaults.expo-file-system: the Android READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE, WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE and INTERNET permissions
defaults.expo-dev-client: the exp+<slug> scheme, a local-network purpose string and the _expo._tcp Bonjour service (an Xcode build phase strips those two from non-Debug builds)
